features.quote: Caps: 40 turns or 120k cumulative context, whichever first.
Early loop termination (cost saver): if 5 consecutive tool calls are byte-identical or the last 4 assistant messages exceed 0.92 ROUGE-L pairwise similarity, terminate and label early_stop_loop.
features.justification_quote: Saves roughly 30–40% of tokens since spiraled runs are the longest.
